description:
WHO WE ARE

GridUnity is the industry leader in interconnection life cycle management, delivering cutting-edge software solutions that eliminate bottlenecks in the interconnection process and accelerate the transition to a more affordable, sustainable, and resilient energy future.

Our Mission

We unite all grid interconnection stakeholders on a single platform that converts centralized data into actionable intelligence and accelerates the transition to a reliable, sustainable, and cost-efficient electric grid.

GridUnity is a trusted partner to leading utilities, grid operators, and policymakers. Our technology solutions tackle the interconnection queue backlog by significantly reducing processing times. Whether cutting transmission interconnection timelines from years to months or enabling distribution applications to be processed within a day, we help accelerate energy projects at every scale.

Our Vision
Energizing the planet with a faster, smarter, and more sustainable grid.

What You’ll Do

As Technical Project Manager, you will plan and drive complex, cross-team delivery across GridUnity’s engineering organization. You will help shape scope, timing, and phasing with Customer Success, Product and Engineering, then own the path from that plan to a successful release: turning goals into plans, surfacing dependencies and risks early, and keeping work moving across teams.

This is a technical role. You will understand the architecture, integrations, and environments behind the work well enough to ask the right questions, challenge estimates, and help engineers resolve blockers. You will partner with engineering leadership on planning, capacity, and delivery practices, and with Product, Engineering, Quality Engineering, and Customer Experience on scope, timing, and customer commitments.

Your success will be reflected in predictable delivery, fewer late surprises, and stakeholders who trust the status they receive because it is clear, current, and grounded in evidence.

Plan and Drive Delivery

  • Lead planning for cross-team initiatives and releases, turning goals and scope into milestones, sequencing, and clear ownership.

  • Work with engineering leads to break down work, validate estimates, and build plans that reflect real capacity, dependencies, and risk.

  • Run engineering team ceremonies and the broader delivery cadence for your programs, including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, retrospectives, dependency reviews, and release readiness reviews. Keep meetings purposeful and decisions recorded.

  • Establish a clear definition of ready and definition of done with Product and Engineering. Ensure work meets the definition of ready before a sprint commits to it, and meets the definition of done before it is considered complete.

  • Track progress against plan in Jira and related tools, keeping boards, epics, and roadmaps accurate enough to support real decisions.

  • Identify blockers early and drive them to resolution, escalating through the established path when a decision is needed.

Manage Technical Risk and Dependencies

  • Understand the architecture, integrations, data flows, and environments behind each initiative well enough to anticipate where work will get hard.

  • Map dependencies across teams, systems, and third parties, and make sure each one has an owner and a date.

  • Maintain a living risk log for your programs, with likelihood, impact, mitigation, and accountable owners.

  • Partner with Quality Engineering to align validation plans and exit criteria with the release plan before deadlines are committed.

  • Coordinate release and deployment planning with Engineering and DevOps, including cutover steps, rollback plans, and customer-facing timing.

Communicate and Align Stakeholders

  • Provide clear, regular status to engineering leadership, Product, and Customer Experience: what is on track, what is at risk, and what decision is needed.

  • Make tradeoffs between scope, timing, and quality visible, and help stakeholders make informed decisions rather than discovering them late.

  • Translate technical detail into language that nontechnical stakeholders and customer-facing teams can act on.

  • Support customer implementation and utility-facing commitments by keeping delivery dates realistic and changes communicated early.

Improve How We Deliver

  • Partner with engineering leadership to improve planning, estimation, capacity management, and delivery practices across teams.

  • Define and use meaningful delivery measures, such as predictability against plan, cycle time, dependency lead time, and release outcomes.

  • Lead retrospectives on major initiatives and follow through on improvements that reduce recurring delays.

  • Use AI-assisted tools where they improve planning, reporting, or coordination, with appropriate review so their output is trusted only when it has been checked.

  • Share effective practices across GridUnity’s product lines, adapting the approach to each team’s size, maturity, and risk profile.

What You’ll Bring

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 6+ years of experience in technical project management, program management, software engineering, or a related technical delivery role, including 3+ years managing cross-team software initiatives.

  • A track record of delivering complex SaaS releases on time by building realistic plans, managing dependencies, and adapting as conditions change.

  • Enough technical depth to understand system architecture, APIs, integrations, environments, and CI/CD workflows, and to engage credibly with engineers on design and estimation.

  • Experience running Agile delivery (Scrum, Kanban, or a hybrid) and adapting processes to fit the team rather than the other way around.

  • Proficiency with Jira or comparable tools for planning, tracking, and reporting on work across multiple teams.

  • Ability to identify, quantify, and communicate risk, and to drive decisions on scope, timing, and quality tradeoffs.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to give concise status to executives and detailed direction to engineering teams.

  • Comfort leading through influence: aligning people who do not report to you around shared plans and priorities.

  • Strong organizational skills and follow-through, with a habit of making ownership and next steps explicit.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Domain Expertise: Background in energy, utilities, grid management, or regulated sectors with extended customer sign-off cycles.

  • Enterprise Implementation: Proven success deploying enterprise software or complex integrations for large clients alongside continuous core product releases.

  • Scale & Governance: Track record of maturing delivery processes or establishing project management frameworks within expanding SaaS organizations.

  • Technical Tooling: Working knowledge of modern tech stacks such as TypeScript, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, and AWS.

  • Roadmapping & Collaboration Tools: Proficiency with Confluence, Jira Advanced Roadmaps, or equivalent platforms for documentation and cross-functional alignment.

  • AI Integration: Experience leveraging AI-driven tools to enhance planning, status reporting, and cross-team coordination.

  • Professional Certifications: PMP, PgMP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent credentials.

OUR CULTURE

We are a lean, fast-moving team that values bold thinking, reliability, and continuous learning. We operate with radical transparency, embrace scrappiness, and build solutions that anticipate customer needs. We also believe work should be fun and fulfilling — what we call “funfillment.”

The right candidate is energized by working in a scaling, mission-driven company where they can shape processes, wear multiple hats, and grow alongside the business.

BENEFITS/PERKS

  • Competitive compensation packages that recognize your expertise and contributions

  • Remote-first culture that provides flexibility and balance

  • Professional development opportunities, including training, mentorship, and career pathing

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one

  • Short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance at no cost to you

  • 401(k) plan with a 4% match to help secure your future

  • Flexible PTO and a supportive work culture that values balance

  • Mission-driven work with the opportunity to make a significant impact in the energy sector

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENT

This position may involve access to data and systems subject to U.S. critical infrastructure protection regulations. Accordingly, this role is restricted to individuals who qualify as “U.S. persons,” defined by federal law as U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), asylees, or refugees.

OUR COMMITMENT TO APPLICANTS

GridUnity is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, arrest and conviction record, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued, supported, and able to bring their authentic self to work.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please email careers@gridunity.com.

For your security, all official communication from GridUnity will only come from email addresses ending in @gridunity.com.
